messages:
Maya (Product): Thank you — quick capture of follow-ups from today's all-hands on GPU capacity ramp & autoscaler.
Diego (CTO): High level: EMEA wave in July, APAC pilot in August, NA steady additions through Q3. Procurement window closes in Q3; expect intermittent regional shortages until the ramp completes.
Sam (Infra SRE): Autoscaler default keeps serving in-region. Cross-region routing only when account policy allows and local queue exceeds threshold.
Jin (Runtime): Cross-region failovers will pick compatible/quantized variants to avoid model mismatch. Note: KV cache is region-tagged, so failovers cause session-level cold misses.
Ava (Procurement): Confirmed +40 A100 GPUs, ETA end of July. Working to expedite a small tranche for priority enterprise customers.
Sam: Measured extra latency for cross-region fallback: median +70-130ms depending on pair; p95 can reach ~300-450ms for intercontinental hops.
Liam (Support): Can we get a short customer blurb to paste into support templates?
Maya (Product): Draft blurb: "We're expanding regional GPU capacity. During the ramp some requests may be routed cross-region which can add ~100ms latency for affected calls. To guarantee region-only serving, reserve Dedicated capacity or request regional pinning." Thoughts?
Diego (CTO): Add: "Reserved/Dedicated capacity is exempt from cross-region fallback. See status.redwood.ai for live updates."
Jin (Runtime): We're adding session_affinity (TTL default 5m) to reduce KV-cache churn during short failovers. Ops will also get an emergency toggle to disable fallbacks mid-rollout.
deploy-bot: autoscaler/v2 -> canary clusters succeeded 2026-03-22T15:04Z :white_check_mark:
Sam: Rollout plan: canaries this week, 50% cluster rollout next week, full roll by end of month if no regressions. Ops dashboard toggle targeted mid-next week.
Ava: No global quota changes today. Account managers can request reserved capacity for enterprise tenants; other tenants may experience temporary regional throttles.
Diego (CTO): Customer playbook: 1) Reserve Dedicated capacity, 2) set allow_cross_region_fallback=false in Console/CLI to enforce regional-only serving (note: this may cause rejections during local exhaustion), 3) talk to AM for priority shipments.
Jin (Runtime): Example CLI snippet: 
```
redwood route update --allow-cross-region-fallback=false --session-affinity=300
```
Maya (Product): Action items: Sam will paste measured medians/p95s for common region pairs into the Q&A doc by EOD; Diego will draft the 3-line external message for review. Closing the loop 94 thanks everyone.
